$comment: The public-surface gate's axes for @cosyte/ccda, read by `cosyte-internal-refs` (pnpm check:no-internal-refs), the shared gate in @cosyte/script-utils. This file adds detection and never subtracts. The three extra rules carry this repository's former phase, slice and roadmap-citation rules as they were, so the shared gate reads at least what the former scripts/check-no-internal-refs.sh read.
$prefixes: Keyed on our own programme prefixes, never on a WORD-N shape: CONF:1098-30468, ICD-10-CM, CPT-4 and PHQ-9 are reference material here. SYNTH is deliberately absent: MRN-00042, DOC-0001 and SYNTH-9 are the synthetic example ids our docs use.
$surface: What a consumer reads: README.md, LICENSE, and docs-content/ (docs.cosyte.com). CHANGELOG.md is where identifiers belong, and dist/ is built from src/, whose doc comments and string literals are scanned below.

Document carries 3 sections; only the first is decoded. The slice thickness and the number of slices are imaging attributes.
